items.title: Jimmy Cobb — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I did a couple things for her up in Canada.

ctx.x: Why do you think he was underrated?

Because people just didn’t realize how good he was. In fact, just lately I was talking to Monty Alexander. He’s 80. He came to me. He says – because he met me – when he met me, he was talking about Wynton. He’d just come from Jamaica. He’s the one who put this back in my mind. He says, “Man, we should really do something about Wynton, because Wynton is one of the underrated piano players of all time.” You hear him say that. He’s a good piano player too. So I say, “Yeah. You just made me think about it.” But his…
